content: Neocate Junior is prescribed with specific dosing based on the indication, taking into account factors such as age, body weight, and the underlying medical condition. It is primarily used for patients with gastrointestinal tract impairments, malabsorption issues, multiple food protein intolerances, cow milk protein intolerance, or other medical conditions that necessitate an amino acid-based diet. This product is not indicated for children aged 1 to 10 years unless clinically appropriate based on the aforementioned factors. It is unsuitable for children under one year of age and is not intended for parenteral use. Its administration must occur under strict medical supervision. No clinical studies have been conducted to evaluate its safety or efficacy in certain populations. It is not associated with any specific pregnancy category, as it is designed exclusively for pediatric use. Similarly, lactation considerations are not applicable for this product due to its pediatric-specific indication. In general, the product is considered acceptable for use in its intended population. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk, but this information is not directly relevant to Neocate Junior, given its pediatric focus.
